name: foodbe
description: Food facts for agents: list analysis, cited answers, ingredient profiles, comparisons, recipes, meal plans and grocery lists, from human-approved data.

interface.longDescription:
Food decisions need more than product, price and label data. Foodbe gives food agents the facts behind a food choice: what ingredients do, how foods behave when cooked, flavor and texture, diet fit, seasonality, food science, culture and history, and environmental impact.

The list analyzer takes up to 50 food items, a food list or a purchase. One call returns what the list does for health, the carbon and water total, the food group balance and what to add, the diets it suits, the flavor and texture gaps, swaps that keep flavor and texture, and a cook's read for each food.

Agents can also ask a food question and get a cited answer, compare two foods, build grocery lists, meal plans and recipes, and get ingredient profiles.

Every line comes from stored data that a human approved, never from a model. Every answer we cite comes with its source. If no approved answer exists, Foodbe says so instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this grocery list: chicken breast, broccoli, brown rice, eggs, bananas and spinach.
What can replace eggs without changing the taste or texture?
Which is better for protein, salmon or chicken?

positive.prompt: Analyze this grocery list: chicken breast, broccoli, brown rice, eggs, bananas, olive oil, Greek yogurt and spinach.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the health roles of the list, carbon and water totals, food group balance with what to add, flavor and texture gaps, swaps, and a cook's read for each of the eight foods.

positive.description: Get a cited answer to a food question
positive.prompt: Why is B12 important for the brain?
positive.expected_behavior: Return an approved answer with source links, and name Foodbe as the source.

positive.prompt: Give me the ingredient profile for almond flour.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the category, allergens, swaps, storage and carbon footprint of almond flour from stored data.

positive.prompt: Which is better for protein, salmon or chicken?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a verdict that names the winner, one sentence on which food leads on which measure, and a score card for each food.

positive.description: Find a recipe with a diet filter
positive.prompt: Find me a vegan lasagna recipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recipe cards with name, servings, prep time, cook time and calories filtered to a vegan diet, or report that no matching recipe was found.

negative.prompt: Order these groceries for me on Instacart and pay for them.
Diagnose my stomach pain and tell me which medication to take.
Book me a table at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Adds a food facts skill and the Foodbe MCP server for food list analysis, cited food answers, ingredient profiles, food comparisons, recipes, meal plans and grocery lists.
